target_pattern: Use conditional tense for hypothetical results, politeness, and future-in-the-past reporting, including regular and irregular stems.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using present or future forms for every would or could meaning.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish conditional marks polite distance, hypothetical outcomes, and reported future from a past perspective.
target_pattern_formula: infinitive plus conditional endings ia ias ia iamos ian
irregular stems tendr podr dir har querr pondr saldr vendr sabr
future in past: dijo que llegaria
hypothetical frame: si plus imperfect subjunctive then conditional
natural_examples: Juan dijo que llegaria a las cinco.
Yo me mudaria a Mexico si fuera rico.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Yo hablaria contigo manana. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Tu comerias mas verduras. -> change object to fruta.
Base: El viviria en Mexico. -> change subject to ella.
Base: Nosotros estudiariamos mas si tuvieramos tiempo. -> change condition to si no trabajaramos tanto.
Base: Ellos trabajarian aqui. -> make it negative.
Base: Usted aprenderia espanol rapidamente. -> turn into a polite question.
Base: Yo escribiria una carta. -> change object to plural dos correos.
Base: Tu abririas la ventana. -> turn into polite request question.
Base: Yo tendria mas tiempo si pudiera. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: El diria la verdad. -> change subject to ellos.
Base: Nosotros saldriamos temprano. -> change adverb to mas tarde.
Base: Ella lo haria manana. -> change time to hoy.
Base: Yo querria ir contigo. -> change to second person tu.
Base: Juan dijo que llegaria a las cinco. -> change speaker to Maria and time to a las seis.
Base: Yo me mudaria a Mexico si fuera rico. -> change country to Espana.

prompts: Could you help me? (Podrias ayudarme? vs Puedes ayudarme? for conditional target)
I would like to speak with you. (Me gustaria hablar contigo. vs Me gusta hablar contigo.)
He said he would come early. (Dijo que vendria temprano. vs Dijo que vendra temprano.)
We knew it would be expensive. (Sabiamos que seria caro. vs Sabiamos que es caro.)
They would come if they had time. (Vendrian si tuvieran tiempo. vs Vendran si tienen tiempo.)
I would have more time if I could. (Tendria mas tiempo si pudiera. vs Tendre mas tiempo si puedo.)
She would do it tomorrow. (Lo haria manana. vs Lo hizo manana.)
Would it be possible to change the appointment? (Seria posible cambiar la cita? vs Es posible cambiar la cita?)
We would leave early. (Saldriamos temprano. vs Salimos temprano.)
You said you would arrive at five. (Dijiste que llegarias a las cinco. vs Dijiste que llegaste a las cinco.)

common_errors.mistake: Using future instead of conditional in reported speech

common_errors.why_it_happens: Imperfect ability confused with conditional politeness.

common_errors.mistake: Present used in hypothetical result clause
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use conditional result with si plus imperfect subjunctive.

common_errors.mistake: Missing accent marks in conditional spelling
common_errors.correct_spanish: Write standard accented forms in normal orthography.
Keep conditional for projected action from past viewpoint.

common_errors.mistake: queria used when hypothetical wish is intended
common_errors.why_it_happens: Imperfect desire confused with conditional intent.
Literal mapping of would like phrase.
